cd /workspace/dev && cat > z3exp.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys, time, statistics
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import z3
import analyze, infer, genbig
from instance import parse_request

x = genbig.gen(1, 'tight')
inst = parse_request(json.loads(json.dumps(x)))
eng = infer._Engine(inst)
assert eng._sat([eng._budget(inst.max_faults)])
lo, hi = 0, inst.max_faults
while lo < hi:
    mid = (lo + hi) // 2
    if eng._sat([eng._budget(mid)]):
        hi = mid
    else:
        lo = mid + 1
k = lo
eng.sol.add(eng._budget(k))

# baseline: push/add/pop
exprs = [eng.link[i][ei] for i in range(eng.S) for ei in range(eng.E) if any(inst.edge_coeff[ei][1])]
def probe_pushpop(n=60):
    ts = []
    for j in range(n):
        e = exprs[j % len(exprs)]
        eng.sol.push()
        eng.sol.add(e <= 1234567)
        t0 = time.process_time()
        r = eng.sol.check()
        ts.append(time.process_time() - t0)
        eng.sol.pop()
    return ts

# assumptions: fresh literal per call, permanent implication
lits = []
def probe_assumptions(n=60):
    ts = []
    for j in range(n):
        e = exprs[j % len(exprs)]
        b = z3.Bool('b%d' % j, ctx=eng.ctx)
        eng.sol.add(z3.Implies(b, e <= 1234567))
        t0 = time.process_time()
        r = eng.sol.check(b)
        ts.append(time.process_time() - t0)
        lits.append(b)
    return ts

t1 = probe_pushpop(60)
t2 = probe_assumptions(60)
print('push/pop: mean %.4f median %.4f total %.2f' % (statistics.mean(t1), statistics.median(t1), sum(t1)))
print('assumpt : mean %.4f median %.4f total %.2f' % (statistics.mean(t2), statistics.median(t2), sum(t2)))
# now repeat: second round with same expressions (state reuse)
t3 = probe_pushpop(60)
print('push/pop 2nd round: mean %.4f total %.2f' % (statistics.mean(t3), sum(t3)))
t4 = probe_assumptions(60)
print('assumpt 2nd round: mean %.4f total %.2f' % (statistics.mean(t4), sum(t4)))
PYEOF
